items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 29.09.2026, posted by an authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a letter posted within Germany counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting; per the tool's current rule (applicable since 2025) this is the 4th day, i.e. Sat 03.10.2026 (this day does not shift even though it is a Saturday/public holiday, Tag der Deutschen Einheit, because this deemed-delivery rule for authority mail does not move). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) then starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so it runs from 04.10.2026 and ends one month later, on Tue 03.11.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is a normal working day, so no further shift is needed. To allow for postal transit, the Widerspruch should be sent by about 28.10.2026.

items.title: Start of the 6-month Fahrtenbuch (logbook) obligation
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben. Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheides.
items.computation: The six-month logbook duty does not start on a fixed calendar date but only once the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), i.e. once the one-month Widerspruch period has expired without an objection being filed, or once a filed Widerspruch has been finally rejected. If no Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft would occur the day after the Widerspruch deadline computed above (i.e. earliest 2026-11-04), and the six-month period would run from that date. Because it is not yet known whether a Widerspruch will be filed, the exact start (and end) date cannot be fixed now.

warnings: The start (and therefore the end) of the six-month Fahrtenbuch obligation depends on when the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), which in turn depends on whether a Widerspruch is filed by 2026-11-03 — the exact start date cannot be computed today.
The bank details in the letterhead (Förde Sparkasse Muster) are the authority's general contact information; no payment is demanded in this letter, so there is nothing to pay against this IBAN.
